about: A slab avalanche in the Raichosawa valley below Tsurugi-gozen, Tateyama (Northern Alps, Japan), in spring snow: a 140 m wide slab broke away on the 33-39 deg west-facing slope at about 2490-2580 m (the crown is a 1.5 m step), ran 300 m down the slope and spread a 4 ha lobe of debris onto the flat valley floor, its toe at 2295 m. The map is centred on the slope's foot; the valley floor fills its west half, where the rescue team sets out from near Raichozawa Hut.
frame: NED metres from the Unreal origin (north = Unreal X, east = Unreal Y); terrain from Copernicus GLO-30 at 36.5860 N, 137.6102 E.
